purpose: Move ASVS from inventory toward evidence-backed applicability by making an unearned PASS impossible to express, and decide the first chapter whose inapplicability is machine-provable.
requiredInvariants: No PASS may be inferred from the presence of MFA, RLS, CodeQL, an SBOM or a passing test; each requirement needs its own evidence.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires a technical justification and at least one condition re-evaluated on every run.
PASS requires the requirement to be APPLICABLE and to carry evidence and conditions.
FAIL stays FAIL and must describe the gap.
A malformed or stale decision is rejected, never silently downgraded to pending.
finalPass stays false while any requirement is NOT_ASSESSED or PENDING_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW.
Requirement prose from the standard must not be copied into the evidence artifact.
Proprietary source must not be sent to any external service; only the pinned public standard is downloaded.
No product logic, dependency, production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: A decision with no conditions fails.
A decision whose condition stopped holding is rejected and the requirement returns to pending.
A PASS on a NOT_APPLICABLE requirement fails.
A decision for a requirement absent from the pinned standard fails.
One pending requirement out of hundreds still blocks finalPass.
V17 WebRTC is NOT_APPLICABLE on machine-verified absence, and V10 OAuth/OIDC is deliberately left applicable.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the seven authorized paths.
